lobby.subtitle: 1v1 Karuta Territory Battle
lobby.noRooms: No open rooms available. Create one above to play!
lobby.ruleDesc: Competitive Karuta rules with song instrumentals. There are 24 cards on the field, with 12 cards in each player's Own Territory. Take a card from your territory to reduce 1 card, or take from the opponent's territory to send 1 of your cards. Touching a Dead Card (Karafuda) is a foul and incurs a penalty card. First to clear all cards from their Own Territory wins.

lobby.ruleIntro: The library provides {{poolSize}} randomly selected songs: {{fieldCards}} are placed on the board ({{ownCards}} cards in each player's Own Territory), while the remaining {{karafuda}} are Karafuda—trap songs with instrumental audio only and no matching card on the board. The first player to clear their Own Territory wins.
lobby.ruleKimariji: The bold text on each card is the shortest unique identifier among the cards on the board. Strike as soon as you hear it; there is no need to wait for the full phrase.
lobby.ruleOkuri: After taking a card from the Opponent Territory, you may choose one of your cards to send to your opponent. Your remaining card count decreases, bringing you closer to victory.
lobby.ruleOtetsuki: Taking the wrong card, touching a Karafuda, or making a false start counts as a foul. After a foul, your opponent chooses a card to send to you.

info.soloP1: Each question plays an instrumental audio clip without vocals. Pick the correct song title from 4 choices before the timer runs out.
info.soloP2: Easy mode features longer clips and distinct choices, ideal for relaxed play. Hard mode features shorter clips, tighter timers, and choices from the same unit or with similar titles for a fierce challenge.
info.versusP1: A 2-player showdown inspired by competitive Karuta rules: listen to the music, react fast to snatch the matching card on the board, and be the first to clear your Own Territory to win.
info.karafudaDesc: Trap songs with no matching card on the board. Touching any card during a dead card counts as a foul—staying calm and holding back is key to victory.
info.kimarijiDesc: The bolded letters on a card represent its shortest unique identifier among remaining cards. Once you recognize that intro snippet, strike immediately without waiting for the full melody.
info.okuriDesc: Taking a card from the Opponent Territory allows you to choose and send any card from your Own Territory to your opponent, bringing you one step closer to victory!
info.otetsukiDesc: Includes taking the wrong card, touching a card during a Karafuda (dead card), or false starts. Each foul penalizes you with an extra card sent from your opponent.
info.disclaimerP1: This project is a non-profit, fan-made derivative work created to provide fun interactions and community engagement for THE IDOLM@STER SHINY COLORS Producers and fans.
